children: Diana Shipping, a 10% owner, reported sales of Genco Shipping & Trading common shares in Form 4. The transactions consisted of three open-market sales on 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-02 at prices of $26.02, $26.64 and $26.73 per share, with a weighted average price of approximately $26.38 per share. The total proceeds reported from the sales were $7,255,250. Following the reported transactions, Diana Shipping directly owns 4,130,585 common shares. The filing states this is an exit filing as the reporting person is no longer a 10% beneficial owner.
